name: Cold Monday
source:
Cold Monday, stories that have one thing in common - it was a cold Monday, the local Sun was shining brightly.

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/wall-188249826_49]VK[/url]]

Modification for [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url].
translation:
寒冷的星期一，故事有一个共同点——那是一个寒冷的星期一，当地的阳光明媚。

[翻译自[url=https://vk.com/wall-188249826_49]VK[/url]]
